findings.title: Public functions renamed/relocated without updating other call sites
findings.body: This refactor renames `mark_failed_threshold` -> `try_incident_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `create_incident_occurrence`, and moves `get_failure_reason`/`get_monitor_environment_context` out of `mark_failed.py` into new modules. The PR only touches these 4 files, but these were previously importable, non-private module-level functions (e.g. `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import mark_failed_threshold`). Any other code or tests outside this diff that import these symbols by their old names/paths (e.g. existing unit tests for mark_failed logic) will now fail with ImportError, since the old names no longer exist in `mark_failed.py`. The PR should audit and update/move all other references to these renamed functions.

findings.title: Unused logger instance
findings.body: A module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is created but never used anywhere in this file. This is dead code carried over from the original `mark_failed.py` without being needed in the new module, and may trigger lint warnings or indicate a missing logging call that was lost during the refactor.

findings.title: Unused logger instance
findings.body: A module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is declared in this new module but is never used within `try_incident_threshold`. This is leftover dead code from the split of `mark_failed.py` and should either be removed or actually used for logging incident creation outcomes.

findings.title: No new/updated tests accompany the extracted logic modules
findings.body: The PR moves substantial behavior (`try_incident_threshold`, `create_incident_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`) into new files `incidents.py` and `incident_occurrence.py`, but no test files are included in the diff. Given the public API surface changed (function names and module paths), existing tests that exercised this logic via `mark_failed.py` need to be relocated/updated to cover the new modules directly, otherwise coverage for this logic could silently be lost or tests could break due to now-invalid import paths.
